q: In one-shot quantum thermodynamics, the maximum work extractable from a single system ρ at temperature T is governed by:
opts: k_BT·S(ρ) (von Neumann entropy — same as i.i.d. average)
exp: Single-shot thermodynamics (Dahlsten et al. 2011): one-shot work W ≤ k_BT·Hmin(ρ). The min-entropy (not von Neumann entropy) governs single-use work extraction. In the i.i.d. limit Hmin^ε/n→S(ρ), recovering classical thermodynamics.
